title: eludite.browser.console input
description: Read a tab's console: console.* calls, uncaught exceptions and the browser's own messages (failed loads, security warnings), oldest first, each with a `seq`. Pass the answer's `next` as `since` to read only what arrived after; `dropped` counts messages lost because the tab keeps the last 2000. Use after a navigation or an action to check for JavaScript errors; `level: error` keeps errors only. Fails with "no tab" when the browser has no tab: call eludite.browser.tab_open first.

since.description: Answer messages after this cursor (default 0: from the oldest kept).

level.description: Only this level and more severe (debug < log < info < warning < error).

pattern.description: Only messages whose text matches. A substring, or a regular expression between slashes (`/err(or)?/`; Rust regex syntax, `/.../i` for case-insensitive).

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
